name: Castle Ardenvale
description: Castle Ardenvale is the royal castle of the knightly court of Ardenvale on Eldraine, home of the Circle of Loyalty and of the Kenrith rulers.

description_citations.text: Rally for the Throne (Throne of Eldraine, 2019), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

summary.text: Castle Ardenvale is the royal castle of the knightly court of Ardenvale on Eldraine, home of the Circle of Loyalty and of the Kenrith rulers.

citations.text: Rally for the Throne (Throne of Eldraine, 2019), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

bio.text: Mankind overthrew the Elven Lords from the mesa that became Castle Ardenvale and founded five knightly courts around the Circle of Loyalty.

citations.text: "Ardenvale", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.
"Eldraine", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

bio.text: Ardenvale fell to the Phyrexian invaders, and Algenus and Linden Kenrith were killed defending it.

citations.text: "Ardenvale", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.
"Algenus Kenrith", section "New Phyrexian Invasion of Eldraine". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.
"Linden Kenrith", section "Phyrexian Invasion". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

bio.text: Will moved rule to Castle Vantress, and Eriette claimed Ardenvale and reanimated the sleepers there as her court with Ashiok.

citations.text: "Ardenvale", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.
"Eriette", section "The Wicked Slumber". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

bio.text: Rowan fought through slumbering knights to enter the castle, and Kellan and Ruby followed her there.

bio.text: Will's knights assaulted the castle, Kellan lashed Ashiok in place so Will could strike them with ice, and Eriette was captured, which ended the Wicked Slumber while Rowan escaped.

status.text: Ardenvale is a ruin, destroyed in the invasion, and its last recorded event is Will's assault that ended Eriette's hold on it.

citations.text: "Ellivere", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.
"Will Kenrith", section "The Wicked Slumber". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Syr Ameril faces dragonfire picturing Castle Ardenvale.
timeline.quote: As the blaze raced toward her, Syr Ameril closed her eyes and pictured Castle Ardenvale so her last thoughts would be of home.

citation.text: Scorching Dragonfire (Throne of Eldraine, 2019), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Mankind overthrows the Elven Lords from the mesa that would become Castle Ardenvale and founds five knightly courts around the Circle of Loyalty.
timeline.quote: mankind took a stand on the mesa that would become Castle Ardenvale and overthrew the Elven Lords that had enslaved them.

citation.text: "Ardenvale", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Ardenvale falls to the Phyrexian invaders; Algenus and Linden are killed in its defense.
timeline.quote: High King Algenus and Queen Linden Kenrith were killed in the castle's defense

citation.text: "Ardenvale", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Will moves rule to Castle Vantress, Eriette claims Ardenvale, and she is eventually deposed and captured by Will.
timeline.quote: She was eventually deposed and captured by Will.

citation.text: "Ardenvale", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Mankind overthrows the Elven Lords who enslaved them on the mesa that became Castle Ardenvale, founding the five courts.
timeline.quote: mankind took a stand on the mesa that would become Castle Ardenvale and overthrew the Elven Lords that had enslaved them

citation.text: "Eldraine", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Three months later Rowan and Will decide to quest for their father, joined by Titus and Cerise.
timeline.quote: Rowan and Will decide to start on a quest to find their father, and Titus and Cerise join them.

citation.work: Throne of Eldraine: The Wildered Quest
citation.text: "Throne of Eldraine: The Wildered Quest", section "Winter". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The twins' parents are killed by the invaders while defending Castle Ardenvale.
timeline.quote: Rowan and Will's parents were killed by the invaders while defending Castle Ardenvale .

citation.text: "Rowan Kenrith", section "Phyrexian Invasion". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Will and Rowan's parents are killed by Phyrexian invaders defending Castle Ardenvale.
timeline.quote: Will and Rowan's parents were killed by the invaders while defending Castle Ardenvale .

citation.text: "Will Kenrith", section "Phyrexian Invasion". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Rowan dreams of a feast where her parents give her their crown and tell her to come to Castle Ardenvale; she wakes resolved to go.
timeline.quote: "Come to Castle Ardenvale. Your blood awaits you there."

citation.work: Wilds of Eldraine | Episode 2: Wandering Knight, Budding Hero
citation.text: "Wilds of Eldraine | Episode 2: Wandering Knight, Budding Hero" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 9 Aug 2023.

timeline.summary: Rowan blasts through Castle Ardenvale's gates and fights her way up the stairs through slumbering knights who attack her, including Saxon and Joshua.
timeline.quote: Aiming at his feet and Saxon's, she channels another blast.

citation.work: Wilds of Eldraine | Episode 3: Two Great Banquets
citation.text: "Wilds of Eldraine | Episode 3: Two Great Banquets" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 10 Aug 2023.

timeline.summary: Kellan and Ruby ride to Castle Ardenvale on ponies and use the second frog potion to jump over its gates.
timeline.quote: They're in the air seconds later.

citation.work: Wilds of Eldraine | Episode 5: Broken Oaths
citation.text: "Wilds of Eldraine | Episode 5: Broken Oaths" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 14 Aug 2023.

timeline.summary: Inside they find Rowan in the throne room studying curse notes; Kellan reads her note about attempting to put people to sleep before she knocks him out with sparks.
timeline.quote: Kellan's vision goes white.

citation.work: Wilds of Eldraine | Episode 5: Broken Oaths
citation.text: "Wilds of Eldraine | Episode 5: Broken Oaths" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 14 Aug 2023.

timeline.summary: Kellan wakes in a cell, freed by Ruby, who says Rowan knocked them out and was trying to work dream magic on him when Will's army arrived.
timeline.quote: "Syr Rowan knocked us both out.

citation.work: Wilds of Eldraine | Episode 5: Broken Oaths
citation.text: "Wilds of Eldraine | Episode 5: Broken Oaths" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 14 Aug 2023.

timeline.summary: Will's knights burst into Ardenvale as Eriette strains to control sleepers and Rowan blasts the floor before Imodane.
timeline.quote: All of this energy she unleashes in a fearsome bolt aimed at Imodane's feet.

citation.work: Wilds of Eldraine | Episode 5: Broken Oaths
citation.text: "Wilds of Eldraine | Episode 5: Broken Oaths" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 14 Aug 2023.

timeline.summary: Rowan and Will confront each other; he pleads for her to come home but she attacks him with her sword.
timeline.quote: "Home is gone, Will!"

citation.work: Wilds of Eldraine | Episode 5: Broken Oaths
citation.text: "Wilds of Eldraine | Episode 5: Broken Oaths" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 14 Aug 2023.

timeline.summary: Kellan and Ruby attack Eriette's throne while Rowan reveals Eriette is their aunt and begs Will to save her; Will says he doesn't know her anymore.
timeline.quote: "I don't know you anymore," he says.

citation.work: Wilds of Eldraine | Episode 5: Broken Oaths
citation.text: "Wilds of Eldraine | Episode 5: Broken Oaths" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 14 Aug 2023.

timeline.summary: Ashiok returns and takes control of the sleepers, turning the battle against Will's knights.
timeline.quote: Veils of black coalesce into Ashiok's elegant form before the gathered army.

citation.work: Wilds of Eldraine | Episode 5: Broken Oaths
citation.text: "Wilds of Eldraine | Episode 5: Broken Oaths" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 14 Aug 2023.

timeline.summary: Kellan lashes Ashiok in place with his golden whip so Will can strike them with a bolt of ice, which makes Ashiok vanish.
timeline.quote: Ashiok lets out a howl of pain as the ice spreads through their body.

citation.work: Wilds of Eldraine | Episode 5: Broken Oaths
citation.text: "Wilds of Eldraine | Episode 5: Broken Oaths" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 14 Aug 2023.

timeline.summary: Ruby holds her blade to Eriette's throat; Eriette tells Rowan by thread to leave and bide their time.
timeline.quote: Go from this place, Eriette says to her. When the time is right, we will meet again.

citation.work: Wilds of Eldraine | Episode 5: Broken Oaths
citation.text: "Wilds of Eldraine | Episode 5: Broken Oaths" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 14 Aug 2023.

timeline.summary: Rowan blasts the floor and rises into the air, vowing one day to bring the blessed slumber to all of Eldraine, and escapes.
timeline.quote: A boom louder than the fall of a giant.

citation.work: Wilds of Eldraine | Episode 5: Broken Oaths
citation.text: "Wilds of Eldraine | Episode 5: Broken Oaths" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 14 Aug 2023.

timeline.summary: Will thanks Kellan and Ruby and invites them to the palace; Kellan slips away to the Fae World.
timeline.quote: Outside of Castle Ardenvale he steps into the Fae World.

citation.work: Wilds of Eldraine | Episode 5: Broken Oaths
citation.text: "Wilds of Eldraine | Episode 5: Broken Oaths" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 14 Aug 2023.

timeline.summary: Ashiok and Eriette tell Rowan of her lost spark and family tie; she joins her aunt, and fights Will, who defeats Ashiok and captures Eriette while Rowan escapes.
timeline.quote: Will was able to defeat Ashiok with the help of Kellan and Ruby

citation.text: "Rowan Kenrith", section "The Wicked Slumber". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Will wins Imodane's fealty, assaults Castle Ardenvale, defeats Ashiok with Kellan and Ruby, and captures Eriette, ending the Wicked Slumber; Rowan escapes into the Wilds.
timeline.quote: capture the witch Eriette , ending the Wicked Slumber.

citation.text: "Will Kenrith", section "The Wicked Slumber". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Syr Ameril pictures Castle Ardenvale as a blaze approaches.
timeline.quote: Syr Ameril closed her eyes and pictured Castle Ardenvale

citation.text: Scorching Dragonfire (Foundations, 2024), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Kenrith and Linden are killed defending Castle Ardenvale from the Phyrexians; his armies follow him as Spirits.
timeline.quote: were killed by the invaders while defending Castle Ardenvale

citation.text: "Algenus Kenrith", section "New Phyrexian Invasion of Eldraine". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: At her tenth birthday ceremony Ellivere releases a caged dove and speaks her first word, "fly".
timeline.quote: Only when she spoke the word " fly " to her new friend did it flutter away.

citation.text: "Ellivere", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The New Phyrexian Invasion destroys Ardenvale and Ellivere wanders the Realm helping people.
timeline.quote: After the New Phyrexian Invasion destroyed her home at Ardenvale, Ellivere wandered the Realm

citation.text: "Ellivere", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Eriette reanimates the sleepers as her court in Ardenvale with Ashiok.
timeline.quote: Eriette specifically reanimated the sleeping forms as a court of her own

citation.text: "Eriette", section "The Wicked Slumber". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Eriette entices Rowan Kenrith with promises of power.
timeline.quote: Eriette enticed her with the promise of power, regard, and security.

citation.text: "Eriette", section "The Wicked Slumber". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Eriette is captured by Will Kenrith but freed by Jace posing as Ashiok.
timeline.quote: was later freed by Jace Beleren , who masqueraded as Ashiok

citation.text: "Eriette", section "The Wicked Slumber". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Syr Ginger awakens in the Castle Ardenvale kitchen as Garruk breaks in; she falls into a cauldron when Garruk's axe separates her from the gingerbread man.
timeline.quote: they were separated by Garruk's axe, causing her to fall into the cauldron

citation.text: "Ginger", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Ginger witnesses Garruk eating the gingerbread man and leaps at him with a fork to avenge him.
timeline.quote: emerged only to witness the gingerbread man being eaten by Garruk

citation.text: "Ginger", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: After Algenus's disappearance, Hazel spots a blue faerie infiltrator and kills it with her sling, alerting Will.
timeline.quote: she killed the faerie mid-flight

citation.text: "Hazel Kenrith", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Hazel overhears rumors that Linden murdered Will and Rowan's mother; Will reassures her.
timeline.quote: Will reassured her

citation.text: "Hazel Kenrith", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Hazel witnesses Rowan and Will decide to seek their missing father and is tasked with informing Linden.
timeline.quote: Hazel pledged her support and was tasked with informing Queen Linden of their departure.

citation.text: "Hazel Kenrith", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Imodane pledged fealty to Will and helped capture Eriette, ending the Wicked Slumber.
timeline.quote: helping to capture the witch Eriette and end the Wicked Slumber

citation.text: "Imodane", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Linden is slain by a Phyrexian behemoth while defending Castle Ardenvale.
timeline.quote: Linden was slain by a Phyrexian behemoth

citation.text: "Linden Kenrith", section "Phyrexian Invasion". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Captured by Rowan Kenrith, Kellan and Ruby escape when Will Kenrith's knights assault Castle Ardenvale; Eriette is captured and Rowan escapes.
timeline.quote: allowing Will's knights to capture Eriette, though Rowan escaped

citation.text: "Ruby", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

relations.quote: If you're as loyal as you claim, now is the time to show it.

citation.text: Rally for the Throne (Throne of Eldraine, 2019), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.
